queries.query: SELECT t.bulan, t.jumlah_sq, t.jumlah_so, t.jumlah_do, t.jumlah_dr, t.jumlah_si, ROUND((t.jumlah_so / NULLIF(t.jumlah_sq, 0)) * 100, 2) AS cr_sq_ke_so_pct, ROUND((t.jumlah_do / NULLIF(t.jumlah_so, 0)) * 100, 2) AS cr_so_ke_do_pct, ROUND((t.jumlah_dr / NULLIF(t.jumlah_do, 0)) * 100, 2) AS cr_do_ke_dr_pct, ROUND((t.jumlah_si / NULLIF(t.jumlah_dr, 0)) * 100, 2) AS cr_dr_ke_si_pct, ROUND((t.jumlah_si / NULLIF(t.jumlah_sq, 0)) * 100, 2) AS cr_sq_ke_si_pct FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sq.sqtgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, COUNT(DISTINCT sq.sqid) AS jumlah_sq, COUNT(DISTINCT so.soid) AS jumlah_so, COUNT(DISTINCT dox.doid) AS jumlah_do, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.drid) AS jumlah_dr, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m5_si si WHERE siisclose = 0 AND (si.siiddr = dr.drid OR si.siiddo = dox.doid OR si.siidso = so.soid OR si.siidsq = sq.sqid)) THEN sq.sqid END) AS jumlah_si FROM m5_sq sq LEFT JOIN m5_so so ON so.soidsq = sq.sqid AND so.soisclose = 0 LEFT JOIN m5_do dox ON dox.doidso = so.soid AND dox.doisclose = 0 LEFT JOIN m5_dr dr ON dr.driddo = dox.doid WHERE sq.sqisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sq.sqtgl, '%Y-%m')) t ORDER BY t.bulan

queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS customer_code, c.knama AS customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT si.siid) AS total_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi) AS total_nilai_invoice, SUM(si.sijmlbayar) AS total_terbayar_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding_invoice, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sistatuslunas <> 'LUNAS' OR si.sijmlbayar < si.sitotaltransaksi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jumlah_invoice_belum_lunas, COALESCE(sr.total_retur, 0) AS total_nilai_retur, COALESCE(sr.jumlah_retur, 0) AS jumlah_dokumen_retur FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.srcustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_retur, SUM(s.srtotaltransaksi) AS total_retur FROM m5_sr s GROUP BY s.srcustomer ) sr ON sr.customer_id = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND si.sicustomer = ( SELECT x.sicustomer FROM ( SELECT si2.sicustomer, SUM(si2.sitotaltransaksi - si2.sijmlbayar) AS outstanding_total FROM m5_si si2 WHERE si2.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY si2.sicustomer ORDER BY outstanding_total DESC LIMIT 1 ) x ) GROUP BY c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama, sr.total_retur, sr.jumlah_retur

queries.purpose: Menampilkan outstanding invoice per customer dalam bucket umur piutang untuk invoice 90 hari terakhir.
queries.query: SELECT c.knama AS customer_nama, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS outstanding_total, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, si.sitgljatuhtempo) <= 0 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS belum_jatuh_tempo, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS aging_1_30_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS aging_31_60_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS aging_61_90_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 90 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS aging_diatas_90_hari FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND si.sitgl >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ORDER BY outstanding_total DESC LIMIT 100

queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.knama AS customer_name, COALESCE(si_summary.jumlah_sales_invoice, 0) AS jumlah_sales_invoice, COALESCE(si_summary.total_nilai_sales_invoice, 0) AS total_nilai_sales_invoice, COALESCE(sr_summary.jumlah_sales_return, 0) AS jumlah_sales_return, COALESCE(sr_summary.total_nilai_sales_return, 0) AS total_nilai_sales_return, COALESCE(sie_summary.jumlah_tukar_faktur, 0) AS jumlah_tukar_faktur, COALESCE(sie_summary.jumlah_sumber_si, 0) AS jumlah_sumber_si_di_tukar_faktur, COALESCE(sie_summary.jumlah_sumber_sr, 0) AS jumlah_sumber_sr_di_tukar_faktur FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT si.sicustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.siid) AS jumlah_sales_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi) AS total_nilai_sales_invoice FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY si.sicustomer ) si_summary ON c.kid = si_summary.customer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sr.srcustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.srid) AS jumlah_sales_return, SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi) AS total_nilai_sales_return FROM m5_sr sr GROUP BY sr.srcustomer ) sr_summary ON c.kid = sr_summary.customer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sie.siekontak AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sie.sieid) AS jumlah_tukar_faktur, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sied.sumber = 'SI' THEN CONCAT(sied.sumber, '-', sied.idtransaksi) END) AS jumlah_sumber_si, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sied.sumber = 'SR' THEN CONCAT(sied.sumber, '-', sied.idtransaksi) END) AS jumlah_sumber_sr FROM m5_sie sie INNER JOIN m5_sie_detail sied ON sie.sieid = sied.idsie GROUP BY sie.siekontak ) sie_summary ON c.kid = sie_summary.customer_id WHERE c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(si_summary.jumlah_sales_invoice, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(sr_summary.jumlah_sales_return, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(sie_summary.jumlah_tukar_faktur, 0) > 0) ORDER BY jumlah_sales_return DESC, jumlah_tukar_faktur DESC, total_nilai_sales_return DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Risiko Outstanding dan Aging Customer
queries.purpose: Menampilkan customer dengan outstanding invoice tinggi dan aging panjang sebagai proksi collection lambat.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS customer_code, c.knama AS customer_name, COUNT(si.siid) AS total_invoice_open, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 0 AND COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_outstanding, MAX(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgl)) AS max_aging_invoice_days, MAX(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE NULL END) AS max_overdue_days, AVG(CASE WHEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) > 0 THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgl) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_aging_open_invoice_days FROM m5_si AS si INNER JOIN m1_contact AS c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) > 0 GROUP BY c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama ORDER BY overdue_outstanding DESC, max_overdue_days DESC, total_outstanding DESC LIMIT 100
